stops.note: the tree is native to the Western Ghats of southwest India; Kerala made it its official state fruit in 2018
Garcia de Orta's Colóquios dos Simples, printed in Goa in 1563, describes the jaca among the plants of India
English 'jack' from Portuguese, with 'fruit' added; its shredded unripe flesh became a popular meat substitute in the 2010s

current_meaning: a very large tropical fruit of the jack tree
